_comment: Cells of the BirdNET+ Taxonomy that are known to be wrong and are never imported by cmd/import-taxonomy. Keyed by locale, then scientific name; value is the wrong value, reason says why. An excluded en cell becomes the scientific name. scripts/validate.py fails when a listed value is present in the data.

Lemmus lemmus.reason: names the Amur lemming (Lemmus amurensis), a different species

Carineta cearana.reason: names a frog; the species is a cicada

Gopherus agassizii.reason: names the Sonoran desert tortoise, a different species (Gopherus morafkai)
Gopherus agassizii.value: Tortuga patona del desierto de Sonora

Lilioceris merdigera.reason: Dutch name in the Spanish locale

Saimiri ustus.reason: Portuguese name in the Spanish locale

Vitreorana eurygnatha.reason: truncated Portuguese name in the Spanish locale

Anguilla rostrata.reason: names a moray, not the American eel
